summary.text: Denny Wells is the Democratic candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Mia Costello (R).
Wells was born in Anchorage, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Alaska Fairbanks, and has worked as a small business owner, data analyst and in the oil industry.

paragraphs.text: Wells has run for District 15 before: in 2022 he lost the general election to Thomas McKay by 9 votes in the final ranked-choice round, and in 2024 he lost to Mia Costello, 45.5 percent to 51.5 percent.
In the August 18, 2026 primary, Wells received 50.8 percent of the vote to Costello's 49.2 percent.
According to Ballotpedia, Wells has been affiliated with St. John United Methodist Church, Chugach Optional Education Corp, Anchorage Opera and Alaska Returned Peace Corps.
